title: 2nd Sitting of third session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/2/3/2026).
Preliminary debate on the Asset Recovery Bill (on property obtained through crime), submitted on behalf of the government by Fuvahmulah Central MP Ali Fazad.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Criminal Procedure Act (Law No. 12/2016), submitted on behalf of the government by Funadhoo MP Mohamed Mamdhooh.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: MPs held the opening debates on two government bills: a new Asset Recovery Bill for seizing property gained through crime, and changes to the Criminal Procedure Act.
